title: Beet-pulp and other waste of sugar manufacture

review.classification: UNSD page 199 positively includes beet-pulp in 39149 and assigns cane extraction fibre to 39141. The fresh pressed single feed material retains its beet extraction origin. Blending, preservation and other residue families are explicitly outside the selected product.
review.state_and_route: Südzucker identifies fresh pressed pulp as a saleable endpoint after mechanical pressing, separate from further drying, molassing and pelleting. Nordzucker independently documents the pressed state and factory-dependent dry substance. Their specifications support the physical product family. Actual pressed state, composition and release evidence come from the applicable lot and receiver.
review.quantity_and_allocation: Compared both language editions for wet Q at the first full quality release, zero-output periods, non-additive moisture subledgers, matched press-water returns, and separate accounting for current release and previously released gate-service lots. Each supplier joint vector enters once. Dedicated and residual rules are technically separated and preserve unallocated physical quantities.
review.native_and_bilingual: Twelve flow originals and two mass property/unit originals are byte-identical to their pinned historical archive. Three unsupportable archived lookups are unbound and flagged. The exact product reference UUID and current supplier and platform compatibility require study-level evidence. Both languages use substantively equivalent eligibility, boundaries, equations and evidence conditions.
